notes:
- Arnold StandIn (.ass) texture paths no longer break when files move between machines or students: exported .ass files get project-relative texture paths, and TP_pipe keeps Arnold's Texture Search Path pointed at the scene's project.
- Texture Connect now fixes selected StandIns: it reads every .ass (all frames of a sequence, .ass.gz too), finds broken textures in the project's asset texture folders, and rewrites the files (a .bak of each original is kept).
